sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesia renewables names on local strength: TOBA (+7.55%) and TPIA (+3.31%) lead on domestic policy momentum and captive industrial demand, while US-listed peers drag on macro. Rotate into ID-exposed pure-plays (LAPD, ARKO) and avoid US climate-tech laggards until rate clarity. Target TOBA and TPIA for near-term alpha; hold PKPK/MPOW for structural upside.

Rotate into food-service and specialty retail sub-sectors with earnings momentum, avoid broad index exposure. Target 3-6 week horizon, set tight stops at 5% below entry given normal signal volatility.
